name: artifact-viewer-fonts
description: Vendors the brand typefaces (Schibsted Grotesk, Fraunces; both SIL OFL) into internal/api/assets/fonts (see `make assets`), so the app serves them from its own origin, never a third-party CDN. Fraunces is instanced to a static file with fontTools. Node is a build-time-only dependency; python3 + fonttools/brotli are required.
